[[Andorra]] competed at the [[1980 Summer Olympics]] in [[Moscow]], [[Soviet Union|USSR]].  In partial support of the [[American-led boycott of the 1980 Summer Olympics]], Andorra competed under the Olympic Flag instead of its national flag.
